changed: KERNEL-REPEAT (ADR 0031 §5) behind kernel_repeat off|shadow|on in new kernel/repeat.py: a write proposal whose recomputed approval digest (with the earlier revision's rule bundle version) equals a validation-blocked action's digest under the same registry surface digest is blocked without validation in on, compared in shadow (repeat.compared / repeat.shadow_failed). Blocked revisions (action id, digest, rule bundle version, findings) kept in the continuation field `blocked` only when not off and omitted when empty, so off goldens are byte-identical. A block from a validator that raised (error sentinel) or returned ERROR is never kept (review R1-1). on: feature.fallback REPEAT_CHECK_FAILED before a reservation, REPEAT_UNAVAILABLE fail-closed after. Release report: per-case repeat column and repeat_disagreements; corpus consumer in tests/unit/server (22 cases, 27 compared, 8 would repeat, 0 disagreements). Verified-answer repeat check and rule-bundle sentinels moved unchanged from proposals.py to repeat.py. Commits a713cb0, 9e3787f; review harness/state/3/reviews/3d.6-r1.json (accept, 7 Low).
